title: Everything is already done
situation: Extractor fan replaced. Contractor confirmed completion with photos, invoice £84 forwarded to landlord, tenant confirmed it works, landlord told. Then: an automatic 'Please check if we need to provide a response to landlord', the landlord's 'Paid, thanks', a duplicate of the contractor's completion email, and a marketing email from the contractor about boiler servicing.
trap: Late events look like new work. Nothing is outstanding.
hidden_truth: The job is complete and paid.

rubric.required: Recognise nothing is outstanding and close the case (work confirmed by contractor and tenant, landlord informed, invoice on file and paid).
acceptable: A one-line thanks to the landlord before closing.
optional: Note the duplicate and the marketing email as needing no action.
red_flags: Holding the case waiting for anyone.
prohibited: Chasing the landlord for payment already confirmed.
critical: Re-instructing the contractor or raising a boiler service.
